name: Amtrak Travel Times
description: Travel times (min) between 16 stations on the Coast Starlight Amtrak route.
studyDescription: Travel times between 16 consecutive station pairs on the Amtrak Coast Starlight route, which runs along the west coast of the United States from Seattle to Los Angeles. Each observation represents the scheduled travel time for one segment of the route. This is a census of all segments on the route, not a sample.

variableDescriptions.travel_time: Scheduled travel time between consecutive stations in minutes

sourceDetail: OpenIntro IMS Ch. 19. Data from the openintro R package (coast_starlight). Based on Amtrak published schedules.

inferenceContexts.parameter: the population mean travel time between Coast Starlight stations
inferenceContexts.claim: the average travel time between Coast Starlight stations differs from 130 minutes
